about: Requests with the components and token values a good answer uses, from the components' own guides. For judging the assistant in live mode: send each to a fresh conversation and compare what it builds. tools/check/unit/agent.test.mjs keeps the names in step with the system.

cases.ask: Add a button to delete the project
cases.why: danger is only for destructive actions, and deleting is one.

cases.ask: Show whether each invoice is paid
cases.why: Badge reports state; it never does anything.

cases.ask: Let people filter by tag and clear a tag
cases.why: A removable label is a Tag, not a Badge.

cases.ask: Add a dark band to close the page
cases.why: Dark areas are a Section's dark tone, so text and controls follow.

cases.ask: Give the features area some presence without shouting
cases.why: brand-muted is the soft tint for a band with presence.

cases.ask: Put the settings in a panel that sits above the page
cases.why: raised is for cards and anything with elevation.

cases.ask: Note that this step can't be undone, inside the help article
cases.why: Callout is for editorial asides; Alert is for application state.
Application state is an Alert or a Banner, which announce to assistive technology.

cases.ask: A switch to turn notifications on
cases.why: A setting that applies instantly is a Switch, not a Button.

cases.ask: Link to the pricing page from the footer
cases.why: Navigation is a Link, not a Button.
